newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh President wants students shun politics.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh President wants students shun politics.

text.p: Bangladesh President Shahabuddin Ahmed on Thursday asked the government and opposition parties not to use students as political tools.
"I still hope that political parties will respond to my appeal in the interest of the nation," Ahmed told a convocation ceremony at a university in the southern town of Khulna.
"The conscious student community should be alert that they are not used as weapons by their political mentors," said Ahmed, a retired chief justice.
A similar call by Ahmed last year has gone unheeded, with students in universities and colleges frequently fight among themselves to setle political scores.
Two students had been killed earlier this month in southeasrn town of Feni in gunbattles betwen supporters of ruling Awami League and main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party.
Ahmed said: "It's unfortunate that students are used (by their political masters) to disrupt meetings of rival parties or implement their own political programmes.
"Such acts only pollute the academic atmosphere, and must be given up."
